proxy_reward_note: Agents are NOT trained on the satisfaction term directly. CrossQ cross-normalisation operates on batches containing proxy reward signals.

crossq_specific_notes.cross_normalisation: Normalises batches mixing replay buffer and online transitions for stable Q-learning
crossq_specific_notes.sample_efficiency: Designed for high sample efficiency — fewer gradient updates needed than SAC/TQC
crossq_specific_notes.policy_delay: Actor updated every policy_delay critic updates (similar to TD3)
crossq_specific_notes.vecnorm_compat: VecNormalize (SB3) used for obs normalisation; compatible with sbx via standard Gym API
crossq_specific_notes.first_evaluation: CrossQ had no results in the original EV2Gym paper. This is the first evaluation on this benchmark.

vecnorm_freeze: VecNormalize stats frozen after training (training=False, norm_reward=False) before ALL evaluation episodes.
optuna_asymmetry_note: F2 searches same 30 trials as F1 but across 3 additional YAML dims. F2 HPs may be less well-tuned per dimension.
mpc_horizon_note: EV2Gym paper MPC uses horizon=25 steps (Table VII). Our reproduced variant could not match that config — treated as a distinct controller.
paper_ref_note: CrossQ had no results in EV2Gym Table VII. This is the first reported evaluation. paper_ref set to None.
single_scenario_note: All results are from the workplace scenario only.
statistical_note: High std relative to mean expected in Phase 2. Pairwise differences may not be statistically significant without bootstrap CIs / Wilcoxon tests.
